title.subtitle: Monthly arrivals by origin market. Each panel has its own scale from zero: compare shapes, not heights
title.text: Europe comes in winter, everyone else in summer

__chart__.title: Monthly arrivals by origin market, each panel on its own scale

reading: Four of the five markets peak in July or August and Europe peaks in December, and the season is strongest for the Gulf, whose best month has about four times the arrivals of its weakest. Each panel has its own scale, so the chart does not show that the markets are of similar size: visitors from other regions outnumber visitors from Europe by about eight to one.

__chart__.title: Monthly arrivals by origin market, one scale for all panels
